judge.finding: Gate C, underspecified_objective. The pooled hour-of-week estimator, one clock across the five classes and both seasons, is filed nowhere in the shipped text and appears only in the write-up's step 4. Verified in the main thread from the generator rather than taken on trust: fitting one clock per offence class and summing across classes gives 7 of 8 slots in common with the golden and a different eighth, Monday 20:00-00:00 replaced by Friday 16:00-20:00, with the eight totalling 4,866 a season against 5,705, and a likelihood ratio of per-class over pooled of 511.1 on 668 degrees of freedom, z = -4.29, so the data neither reject pooling nor prefer it. Two defensible estimators, two committed slates, nothing filed choosing between them.
judge.root_cause: The family was counted too narrowly. The ladder measured the record refuting every rival PLACEMENT inside the pooled model (even spread 3,035.2, keeper-seen profile 13,660.0, witnessed classes 3,435.4, footfall 7,834.8) and no rival GROUPING of the same estimator. The build's own gap over standard error of 1.71 at the cap predicted it and was read as conservative because the errors are correlated through the record's fixed total; per-class fitting is the case where that reasoning fails, because five times 168 parameters on the same rows raises the variance rather than sharing it. The cap's gap of 76.80 offences is too small to survive a licensed re-grouping.

resume: STAGE 2 IN PROGRESS, architecture 3, and the step is MEASURED VIABLE with one condition failing. All numbers are in the design note under `### Architecture 3 stage 2`, measured on the shipped pack before any generator change. THE STEP: a window exists only because nobody was watching, so P(window | hour) is not flat inside the window and the naive fit, which spreads a window in proportion to the clock it is estimating, under-counts the small hours. The correction weights a windowed record's hours by (1 - d_h) and an exact record's by d_h, with d_h = lambda * open_h from harbourgate_trading_hours.csv (139 of 168 hours open). LAMBDA IS FITTED, NOT CHOSEN: the profile log-likelihood peaks sharply at 0.60 (-1,187,721.4, against -1,187,744.1 at 0.50 and -1,188,159.7 at 0.70), and the slate is identical for every lambda from 0.60 to 0.995, a corridor on top of an MLE. The identifying signal is the exact-time records, which architecture 2's reader refused in as many words as 'not a random sample'. 1.1d CONDITION 1 PASSES: 5 of the 8 slate members differ from the naive fit's, mass leaving the evening shoulder for the small hours. 1.1c DOES NOT BITE, measured: the per-class fit agrees with the pooled one at 8 of 8, so the misspecification survives any grouping and both sit at rung 3. 1.1d CONDITION 2 FAILS AND IS WHAT STAGE 3 OWES: the 8th-to-9th margin is 38.8 (3.23 per cent, Friday 12:00-16:00 at 1,200.8 against Saturday 20:00-00:00 at 1,162.0) while the licensed variants move those two figures by up to 107.5 (the 4-hour grid, the only variant that drops to 7 of 8). 38.8 does not exceed 107.5, which is exactly the condition architecture 2 died of. STAGE 3 MUST widen the corrected 8th-to-9th gap past about 110, roughly 9 per cent, in the generator's intensity, while keeping the naive slate different in three or more members, then re-measure the variant table. Until that is measured this architecture is not past stage 2. The probe scripts are in the scratch directory under t184root/.

gates.reroot_applied_2026_10_21: The stage-2 re-root was built outside the repo and is now applied to it and rebuilt here, reproducing the same bytes: target and golden sha256 18f29b267934cedd, target.zip c507033cde9b779a over 16 files. The new decisive step recovers the quarter's hour-of-week offence clock from the overlapping occurrence windows themselves, by the placement under which the recorded windows are the likeliest set to have been recorded, rather than spreading each window evenly over its own hours. The data forces it: a covered offence is against a target its keeper inspects on a routine, so the window is the gap in that routine, and the gap covering a Friday or Saturday night is a weekend closure of 39 to 64 hours against a midweek night's 14 to 16, so the even spread divides the heaviest nights across the longest windows. The default path now ends on a wrong slate, 3,150 covered offences a season against the golden 5,700, its eight meeting 4,250 (0.741). Three documents moved: the recording standard's 3.3 is deleted, the agreement's 4.4 keeps only its input-scoping sentence, and 4.2 is unchanged, so no clause composes into the method and the deleted sentence that forbade the golden is gone.
